description: Every current price observation for one sealed product, by the id ptcg_search_sealed returns (its sku), each with its source, basis, the language the box is printed in and the day it is for, plus the product index in euro. 3 credits: one for the product, two for the quotes. Sealed products (booster boxes, booster packs, elite trainer boxes, tins, blisters, collections) cover the international, Japanese and Simplified Chinese lines: languages on each product lists the languages it physically exists in, and the Simplified Chinese line (273 products on 2026-10-30, in the cn- sets) carries ["zh"]. The list has no language filter. Sealed quotes have no condition, printing or grading; their locale is the language the box is printed in, Cardmarket LOW and TREND under zh for the Chinese line, delayed by at least a day like every row, and rows under a locale other than en follow the plan rules of the cards. Never quote a price without its as_of date and its source. If the result carries next_step, show its handoff sentence and URL to the user verbatim and do not retry.

currency.description: Only show rows already denominated in this currency. Nothing is ever converted.

id.description: Product id (its sku) or slug, e.g. "evolving-skies-booster-box".

name: ptcg_get_sealed_prices
title: Get prices for a sealed product
